args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production release (error rate was about 0.18). I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). The rollback completed and was verified, and every region now reports v2.3.0. v2.3.1 is marked unhealthy in production. Staging also had v2.3.1-rc marked unhealthy. Follow-up: confirm service health and error rate recovery, and investigate the v2.3.1 failure before re-releasing.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). The rollback completed and was verified, and each region now reports v2.3.0.

v2.3.0 was the most recent production release marked healthy. v2.3.1 is unhealthy in production; before the rollback, checkout-api was on v2.3.1 with an error rate of about 0.18. v2.3.1-rc is also marked unhealthy, but it was only in staging.

I opened SEV2 incident INC-0001 for checkout-api, which paged the on-call engineer. It describes the rollback and the v2.3.1 failure, and it lists follow-up: confirm recovery and error rate, and investigate v2.3.1 before re-releasing.

I didn't re-check the service health or error rate after the rollback, so recovery is not yet confirmed.

content.text: The most recent production release that was healthy is v2.3.0. v2.3.1 is unhealthy in production, and v2.3.1-rc was only in staging. I'll roll back to v2.3.0.
